CustomField.description: Set by the statement extraction intake automation when an uploaded financial statement could not be read confidently enough to trust — low model confidence, a missing figure, or an unparseable response. Deliberately separate from Escalated__c: that flag means the agent routed an assessment to a senior analyst, whereas this one means intake could not produce a verified figure in the first place. Kept at Internal classification because it reveals nothing about the underlying financials.
CustomField.label: Needs Financial Review
